item.description: The RGM Maintenance team celebrates the Daimler Trucks Townsville win. item.title: $8 million slope repair work begins on Monaro Highway
item.description: Works will take place between Rockton and the Victorian border. Image: Live Traffic NSW Work to repair three locations over a one-kilometre section of the Monaro Highway began last week and will continue for the next five months. Slope repair work is underway at Bondi Walls between Rockton and the Victorian border, around 35 kilometres south of Bombala. item.title: The real cost of sham contracting in the trucking industry
item.description: Government and industry must work together to restore a level playing field. Image: Scott Donkin/stock.adobe.com Sham contracting isn’t a fringe issue in road transport; it’s a systemic problem that’s distorting competition, undercutting honest operators and putting drivers at risk. Across Australia, some operators are engaging drivers as “independent contractors” under an ABN, while treating them like employees in practice. item.title: Truck driver killed in Mount Lindesay Highway rollover
item.description: Investigators from the Forensic Crash Unit are investigating the circumstances of the incident. Image: Qld Police A 39-year-old Beaudesert truck driver was killed in a single vehicle incident on the Mount Lindesay Highway at Innisplain in Queensland earlier today. Initial police investigations indicate the truck was travelling along the Mount Lindesay Highway when it rolled over at around 4.45am.
